shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts && sed -n '1,120p' src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts && sed -n '1,100p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && cat specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md && sed -n '100,270p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && cat package.json && rg --files scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts && sed -n '1,140p' src/transport/ws/sessionListHandler.test.ts && cat AGENTS.md | tail -80 && sed -n '1,35p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md && rg -n 'session_list|list_sessions' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,65p' CHANGELOG.md && rg -n 'conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#|conversationListValidation.test.ts#|sessionListFailure' specs && rg -n 'it\\(|test\\(' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/sessionListFailure.test.ts && git diff --stat"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'Spec Header|validated by|specs/.*#|test anchor' AGENTS.md | head -25 && rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|spec'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && git diff --no-index /dev/null src/transport/ws/sessionListFailure.test.ts || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/conversationListValidation.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/sessionListFailure.test.ts && git commit -m "Log session id for conversation list failures" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status --short --branch'
